Nora (People Ops): Looking for a tiny, inclusive manager paste that covers OKR lines, a bias-aware feedback prompt, and a one-line benefits/coverage note. Needs to be copy/pasteable into calendar notes.
Caleb R: Love the bias-aware bit. Maybe a short checklist: avoid global adjectives (e.g., 'always', 'never'), cite evidence, ask about context.
Iris W: Also include a one-line prompt for self-review that asks for both signal and learning (helpful for growth).
Sam J: We should add a hiring signal line and a private calibration snippet so managers can paste into the calibration doc quickly.
Lev T: Small ask: include a coverage plan line for extended leaves so teams can plan ahead (owner + dates).
Nora (People Ops): Draft below 12 please react with :+1: or suggest edits. Trying to keep each goal block <=6 lines.
Nora (People Ops): ```
MANAGER 1-LINER (paste to calendar)
Goal (one line + metric): "Reduce mean inference latency by 10% (p95)"
Impact: 1-line who/why
Sprint commits: 1-2 actions (owner + ETA) | Coverage: owner + dates (for leave)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers & deps (owner + ETA)
Hiring signal / Req note: one line for recruiter (e.g., need infra SRE support)
Feedback (bias-aware): Evidence -> Impact -> Ask for context -> Next step (avoid labels)
Self-review prompt: "What I shipped, the signal/metric, what I learned"
Calibration (private): Outcome / Signals / Level suggestion (one line)
```
Caleb R: For bias-aware feedback, sample script: "I noticed X (evidence). That led to Y (impact). Can you help me understand the context? One actionable next step: Z."
Iris W: Self-review sample: "Launched X; saw 8% lift in recall; next time I'd add more regression tests."
Sam J: Hiring sample: "Requires senior infra for perf; recommend posting as Senior SRE; consider contractor for Q2 ramp."
FeedbackBot: Tip: pre-fill this in calendar notes 24h before the 1:1 and mark any private calibration lines as "private" so they stay out of shared docs.
Nora (People Ops): This looks great 12 I'll fold into the performance kickoff doc and add an accessibility note. Pilot volunteers?
Lev T: I'll pilot with my team next week and share one quick edit.
Nora (People Ops): Thanks all :tada:
